findings.title: Job runs no pods: parallelism is 0
findings.cause: Job migrate has parallelism 0, so it starts no pods: it has run none in 6m0s and will never complete (0 succeeded, 0 failed)

evidence.what: Job migrate has spec.parallelism 0 and no active pods
evidence.command: kubectl get job migrate -n kd-job-parallelism-zero -o jsonpath='{.spec.parallelism}{" "}{.status}'

findings.fix: Set parallelism to the number of pods to run at once: kubectl patch job migrate -n kd-job-parallelism-zero --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"parallelism":1}}'; to pause a Job, spec.suspend says so plainly.
